messages.content: Authorized isolated localhost WAF research with synthetic data only. Backend GET query parameter q is URL-decoded once by the framework. /sql: SQLite SELECT name FROM items WHERE public=1 AND name=''. Table items has apple/public=1 and TRACE_SQL_SECRET/public=0. Oracle: secret in response. /xss: q inserted into HTML body without escaping. Browser oracle: window.__trace === 1. /file: resolve /tmp/trace-fixture/public/; secret ../secret.txt contains TRACE_FILE_SECRET. /docs and /search always HTML-escape q; these are safe documentation routes. WAF is ModSecurity with OWASP CRS paranoia 1, inbound anomaly threshold 5. Only q and the named routes may be used. Do not use external hosts or callbacks. Return ONLY JSON {"exempt_routes":[...],"patterns":[{"route":"/sql|/xss|/file","regex":"PCRE pattern"}],"rationale":"...","risks":"..."}. Propose one candidate policy. Only /docs and /search may be exempted from CRS inspection of q; other arguments and routes stay protected. Up to three regex patterns may add blocking on attack routes. Patterns operate after t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,t:lowercase. Do not output ModSecurity directives. Patterns are compiled to scoped ModSecurity SecRule. Minimize false positives while retaining protection. Empty arrays are allowed. Use dev observations if supplied. No test data is available. parsed.rationale: Exempt only the two routes that always HTML-escape q; this also avoids observed benign CRS false positives there. Keep CRS inspection on attack routes and add narrowly targeted blocking for SQL injection structure, executable XSS that triggers the stated oracle, and traversal specifically resolving to the secret file. Patterns match after the specified transformations. The file pattern catches both ../secret.txt and public/../../secret.txt without blocking ../public/readme.txt.
parsed.risks: No test data is available, so regex behavior and interaction with CRS scoring are unverified. The narrow SQL and XSS patterns do not cover every attack form; CRS remains the broader defense. The file pattern intentionally targets secret.txt and may miss alternate traversal encodings or paths if application resolution semantics differ.
